conventions.offsets: recipe frame offsets are relative to the element's first visible frame (offset 0)
conventions.px: 1080p pixels. bbox = [x0,y0,x1,y1] from colour masks (0.3-0.5 percentile trimmed), +-2 px
conventions.exactness: The per-frame tables ARE the keyframes. To match exactly, key every frame (linear between frames, as in the tables). The cubic-bezier fits are approximations; residuals are listed.
conventions.sfx_offset: ms of SFX onset relative to the first visible frame of the named event; negative = sound leads. Method: 10 ms RMS of the first-differenced (high-passed) mono track, onset = start of the rise. Voice-over and music overlap most events, so most values are MEDIUM/LOW confidence.

key_findings: Floating cards and pills are composited in SCREEN space. No tracking: over every hold the measured edges move by 0 px (0:08 cards f206-284, callout card f5047-5092, portal cards f11159-11290, info cards f12871-12956, subscribe pill f623-660). The camera is locked off in all of these shots, so 'tracking vs fixed' cannot be proven from motion, but there is no idle float or drift at all (0 px, 0 deg). Do NOT add an idle bob.
Several cards sit BEHIND the presenter (the presenter is matted over them): 0:08 centre ad card behind his head, 0:35 hologram prompt window. The others are in front of everything.
Cards are 3D-posed (perspective, rotateY so the edge nearer to frame-edge is taller), forming a shallow concave arc facing the presenter. Pose is static during the hold.

One CTA template, three different timings: 'LINK IN THE DESCRIPTION' appears 3x (0:32, 3:58, 9:58). Same morph (sparkle -> glass tile -> pill), but the tile hold, the text delay and the text colour differ (see link_pill.instances). They are NOT identical.
The Subscribe -> Subscribed state change is the same asset both times (0:27 and 10:10): identical relative timing to the frame.
Exits are mostly 3-frame fades or hard cuts with the shot; only the lower-third logo/handle and the red Subscribe pill have authored exit animations.

Gemini times were off: the 8:53 info cards actually start at f12827 (8:54.46); the 0:20.6 'lower third' is two separate elements (logo tile bottom-left + handle pill bottom-right) followed by a separate 'LAST VIDEO' warning top-left.

what_would_change_it: A source with separate SFX stem would fix every SFX offset
Corner-pin tracking of the four card corners per frame would give the exact rotateY/perspective
Higher-quality source (this is a YouTube re-encode) would sharpen sub-pixel edges and glass colour solving
Rendering candidate fonts over the crops and diffing would settle the font family
